name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt_prepend
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {hdr v : Nat},
  LE.le.{0} 1 hdr →
    Eq.{1} (m' (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} hdr 1)) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m hdr) 1) →
      Eq.{1} (m' hdr) v →
        (∀ (i : Nat),
            LT.lt.{0} i (m hdr) →
              Eq.{1} (m' (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} hdr 1) i))
                (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} hdr 1) i))) →
          Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m' (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} hdr 1))
            (List.cons.{0} v (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.arrAt m hdr))

source.code:
theorem arrAt_prepend {m m' : Mem} {hdr v : ℕ} (h0 : 1 ≤ hdr) (h1 : m' (hdr - 1) = m hdr + 1)
    (h2 : m' hdr = v) (h3 : ∀ i, i < m hdr → m' (hdr + 1 + i) = m (hdr + 1 + i)) :
    arrAt m' (hdr - 1) = v :: arrAt m hdr := by
  unfold arrAt
  rw [h1, List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
  congr 1
  · rw [show hdr - 1 + 1 + 0 = hdr by omega, h2]
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro i hi
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hi
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [show hdr - 1 + 1 + (i + 1) = hdr + 1 + i by omega, h3 i hi]
